elements.target_operation: The contradictory witness maintains relation strongly enough to make authority answerable; cosmic answer changes field rather than supplying friends’ causal explanation.
elements.whole_figures_and_relations: Job; Yahweh; satan; wife; Eliphaz/Bildad/Zophar; Elihu; biblical Wisdom; whirlwind; Behemoth; Leviathan; friends’ rebuke; intercession/restoration; Jung’s Sophia as distinct later interpretation
elements.whole_sequence: Divine council and wager; loss and bodily affliction; wife’s response; friends first sit in grief then close explanation; Job sustains protest and relation; Wisdom and Elihu broaden field; whirlwind creation exceeds account; Job responds; friends rebuked and intercession/restoration follows. Jung constructs a second God-image/Sophia history over that whole.
specific_boundaries: Biblical Wisdom is not silently Jung’s Sophia; Jung’s Yahweh interpretation is not biblical assertion. Job is one whole with methodological, mythemic and source offices, not another Argument.
